decisions.reason: A formwork profile system with several models and its own page is a core consumable for precast plants, closely tied to the established offer and likely to sell steadily.
Shuttering magnet blocks are a standard, low-risk accessory line that complements the firm's formwork business, even though the website only mentions them.
This magnetic formwork component has its own page and fits the firm's lifecycle and formwork portfolio, so it is cheap to keep and supports system sales.
This component is only mentioned on the website and could be consolidated into the magnet range, but its low maintenance cost and fit with the core offer favor keeping it.
